pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of multiple simultaneous entries in the same price cluster; no scaling into positions when unrealized variance expands beyond 1.5 ATR.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated 5-minute order block mitigation combined with an RSI mean-reversion extreme confirmation before any market execution is permitted.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated trailing stops once floating profit hits +$10.00 to guarantee a minimum +$5.00 capture, eliminating premature exits and zero-bound reversals.
